floors.clue: A kingdom, or a domain of interest or study.
A member of the lowest order of the British nobility.
A territorial division of a country for local administrative purposes.
An extensive group of states or countries under a single supreme authority.
The wife or widow of a duke, or a female holding high noble rank.

A system of government by one person with absolute power.
